t: 2032 — First long-duration mass drivers testbed runs a sealed lifting s
title: 2032 — First long-duration mass drivers testbed runs a sealed lifting s
definition: 2032 milestone on the Star Lifting Operations roadmap.
description:
First long-duration mass drivers testbed runs a sealed lifting stations habitat for 1,000 days on Earth, proving the magnetic extraction recycling math.

What must be true first: the magnetic extraction results have to replicate outside the lab, lifting propulsion manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and plasma handling operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting. The Signature timeline pulls this earlier by integrating the pieces from day one.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed magnetic extraction demonstrations, lifting propulsion cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting plasma handling uptime. When all three flash green, 2032 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (6 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Star Lifting Operations
definition: Estimates Star Lifting Operations readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Star Lifting Operations components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a lifting stations that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Star Lifting Operations Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Star Lifting Operations operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Star Lifting Operations installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 60159 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where magnetic extraction monitoring, lifting propulsion redundancy, or plasma handling maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Star Lifting Operations Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Star Lifting Operations: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Star Lifting Operations — mining a star itself for matter and lifetime extension.

Phase 1 — Prove (magnetic extraction): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (lifting propulsion): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (plasma handling): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (mass drivers): lifting stations as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and stellar system-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
